title: Home Media Inputs and Optional Presenter

notes: Promotes approved Home gaps FG-HOME-001, FG-HOME-002 and FG-HOME-003 without changing the frozen Home hierarchy or shell.
Reuses the existing private S3-compatible object-storage boundary; Cloudflare R2 remains the production backing store rather than introducing another media vendor.
Extends durable simple creation with Brand-authorized media references while preserving existing text/URL-only behavior.
Reuses the governed Presenter eligibility projection; Presenter stays optional and None remains default.
Production direct upload additionally requires existing R2 bucket CORS to allow the Kairo web origins; no bucket-publicity change is authorized.

approvals.rationale: Product Owner agreed to implement Cloudflare R2-backed Photo/Video/Media inputs, reusable Media, and optional Presenter selection while preserving the approved Kairo design DNA.
Existing DEC-012 Presenter/private-media policy and VS-83 private S3-compatible storage boundary remain authoritative; no public-media or provider-secret policy change is introduced.
Product Owner explicitly instructed implementation and required the generation button to reuse the AI/sparkles icon shown by Get recommendations.
Requires immutable implementation candidate and full verification.

postRelease.expectedOutcome: Home Photo, Video, Media and eligible Presenter inputs work against private production storage without visual drift.
